title: Reduced-motion kills the placement highlight entirely, contradicting its own doc comment and the sibling effects' static-pin doctrine
detail: The proc's own comment, the file header ("the highlight is steady"), and the PR body all promise a steady band under reduced motion; the code returns, so placement feedback vanishes. The telegraph and reveal siblings correctly pin static presence instead.
recommended_fix: Under reduced_motion draw the band at a fixed alpha (skip only the k-fade), mirroring spawn_fx_draw_telegraph's static-pin branch — or correct the three comments if absence is intended.

title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy lifecycle procs have zero callers repo-wide
detail: Repo-wide grep finds only the definitions; the actual lifecycle is lazy nil-dynamic append-init plus spawn_fx_reset (app/main.odin:741, harness/run.odin:293). Unused API implying an ownership pattern that isn't followed — mild debt.
recommended_fix: Delete both procs (the pkt_interp lazy-init convention is the real pattern), or call them at View creation/teardown to make ownership explicit.
